Posterior Probability Criteria for Quantitative Decisions

Source: R/class_design_quantitative.R
QuantitativeDecisionThresholds.Rd

Internal ParameterSet holding a conjunction of posterior probability criteria. Obtain instances through getQuantitativeDecisionThresholds().

Details

All criteria must hold, using strict probability comparisons as in RBesT. Thresholds refer to the effect in the beneficial direction.

See also

getDesignQuantitative()

Super classes

FieldSet -> ParameterSet -> QuantitativeDecisionThresholds

Public fields

quantiles

Supplied finite numeric vector of posterior effect thresholds on the beneficial-effect scale, one per criterion. All criteria are combined with logical AND.

probabilities

Supplied numeric vector of strict posterior probability thresholds in (0, 1), one per quantile in the same order.

lowerTail

Supplied logical vector, expanded from a scalar if needed, one per quantile. TRUE specifies P(effect <= quantile) > probability and FALSE specifies P(effect > quantile) > probability.
